tool: built-in ChatGPT image tool (through the codex command line, one call a tier)

tier_1.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original game shop icon, square 1024x1024 with REAL transparent background (RGBA alpha), no opaque backdrop or checkerboard. Style: bold chunky toy-like ocean adventure card art, thick near-black navy outlines, simple broad shapes, glossy cel shading, readable at 180 px. A power-up aura made of UPWARD STREAMING POINTED FLAME TONGUES, not mist or smoke. Transparent/open gaps between flame tongues, with colored translucent flame membranes and solid outlined graphic edges. Subject fully inside image, 7% minimum empty padding all sides. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, ground, floor, ground shadow, disc pedestal or circular badge. Entire outer background transparent. Original design; no recognizable existing anime or game character, hairstyle, outfit, logo or symbol. Not a grey mannequin with a thin colored rim. Keep internal detail deliberately large and simple. Front-facing fish has a broad hammer-shaped face, two tiny side eyes, small friendly open mouth, lateral fins, very compact chunky silhouette. Rider clearly seated above fish. Power-up flame envelops rider with long rising points above head. No water splash, no sea, no ground; isolated rider and fish. tier 1 Bubble (#FFFFFF): WHITE flame, with very pale ice-blue shadows and white highlights, dark navy outline so it reads on cream.
